title: 第十三章 横财第十四章 力量
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
那人瞬间被拽入水下，猝不及防之下，一口冰冷河水灌入口鼻。
窒息的恐惧让他本能地想要挣扎上浮。
然而，迟了。
浑浊的水流中，一柄黑色的钢叉，旋转着，轻松破开水流，精准的刺在他的咽喉上。
“噗嗤！”
利刃破开水阻，精准且无情地贯穿了那人的咽喉。
一蓬凄艳的血花在水中绽放，随即被暗流冲散。那人双眼暴突，身体抽搐了两下，便不再动弹。
船篷内，另一人听到落水声，猛地钻了出来。入眼处，只有那一抹尚未散去的血红，和空荡荡的水面。
“老三？”
“是谁！”
“滚出来！老子是水蛇帮的！”
他心头一凉，抄起旁边的船桨，声色俱厉，大喊一声。
等了一会，水面没有丝毫动静，他有点害怕了，朝着船头岸上挪去。
水底下，苏羽藏在另一侧船头，借助船篷子遮挡着，轻声呼吸着。
没想到杀这人如此轻松，虽然占据了偷袭的便宜，但是也可以看出自己的水中实力不容小觑。
但是若是让这人上岸，正面对上，就没有那么容易了。
正考虑着对策，苏鸿一个箭步冲了出来，手中朴刀朝着那人就是一个偷袭劈砍。
“水蛇帮的狗杂碎，拿命来！”
“啊！”那人看到朴刀砍来，惊骇欲绝，仓促间举起船桨格挡。
“咔嚓！”

坚硬的船桨被一刀劈出裂痕，巨大的力道震得那人虎口崩裂，整个人蹬蹬蹬后退几步，直接退到了船舷边缘，身形摇晃。
好机会！
苏羽猛的破开水面，伸手抓住那人脚踝，一个用力，将其也拽入水中。
贯浪刺！
没有任何花哨，钢叉索命，噗嗤一声刺透那人咽喉。
“哗啦！”
杀死最后一人后，苏羽翻身上船，胸膛剧烈起伏，大口贪婪地呼吸着空气，此刻身体也有些略微脱力。
连续杀死两人，看似顺利异常，但是其中的凶险却是很多。
首先苏羽的力量要够，偷袭之下能够把人拽入水中，然后水中的战斗力要够，尤其是鱼叉的攻击，要又快又猛，不给落水敌人反应时间。
其次杀第二人时多亏了苏鸿正面吸引敌人注意力，给了苏羽偷袭机会。
这其中稍一失误，敌人反应过来，就演变成正面激战了，如此苏羽很可能受伤。
这全靠苏羽练拳后增长的气力，还有鱼骨功提升的水下战力！
“二弟，没事吧？”苏鸿走上前来关切的询问。
“没事。”苏羽摆摆手，平复心跳。
苏鸿看着两具浮尸，眼中闪过一丝赞赏与欣慰。这个往日沉默寡言的堂弟，如今不仅心思缜密，下手更是果决狠辣。
在这乱世，这样才能更好的活下去。
“你先休息，我处理下。”
苏鸿手脚麻利地将两具尸体拖上船，开始摸尸。
片刻后，两个钱袋子摆在了船板上。
“二弟，两人尸体上一共四两银子，你拿着！船蓬里你再搜索一下。”

面对苏鸿递过来的银子，苏羽想要平分，毕竟大哥也出了力。
不过苏鸿坚决不要，“二弟，你如今学武，正是需要钱的时候，你拿着！”，说着便强塞到了苏羽怀中。
苏羽便不再拒绝，将钱袋子仔细塞入怀中，转身进入低矮的船蓬子。
content_en:
The man was instantly pulled under the water, and caught off guard, a mouthful of cold river water poured into his mouth and nose.
The fear of suffocation made him instinctively want to struggle to the surface.
However, it was too late.
In the turbid water, a black steel fork rotated, easily breaking through the water, and stabbed his throat accurately.
"Pfft!"
The sharp blade broke through the water barrier and penetrated the man's throat accurately and ruthlessly.
A bunch of miserable blood flowers bloomed in the water, and were immediately washed away by the undercurrent. The man's eyes bulged, his body twitched twice, and then stopped moving.
In the canopy of the boat, another person heard the sound of falling into the water and jumped out. As far as the eye could see, there was only a hint of blood-red color that had not yet dissipated, and the empty water surface.
"The third child?"
"Who is it!"
"Get out! I'm from the Water Snake Gang!"
His heart felt cold, he picked up the oar next to him and shouted with a strong voice.
After waiting for a while, there was no movement on the water. He became a little scared and moved towards the bow of the ship.
Under the water, Su Yu hid in the bow of the other side of the boat, using the boat's canopy to cover it, breathing softly.
I didn't expect it to be so easy to kill this man. Although he had the advantage of a sneak attack, he could also see that his strength in the water should not be underestimated.
But if you let this person go ashore and face him head-on, it won't be that easy.
Just as he was thinking about countermeasures, Su Hong rushed out with a single step and slashed at the man in a sneak attack with the sword in his hand.
"You bastard from the Water Snake Gang, take your life!"
"Ah!" The man was horrified when he saw the sword coming, and he hurriedly raised his oar to block it.
"Crack!"
The hard oar was cracked by a knife, and the huge force shook the man's jaw to pieces. He took a few steps back and retreated directly to the edge of the ship's side, his body shaking.
What a great opportunity!
Su Yu suddenly broke through the water, reached out and grabbed the man's ankle, and pulled him into the water with a strong force.
Pierce the waves!
There was nothing fancy about it, the steel fork was life-threatening and pierced the man's throat with a pop.
"Wow!"
After killing the last person, Su Yu rolled onto the boat, his chest heaving violently, breathing in the air greedily, and his body was slightly exhausted at this moment.
Killing two people in a row seemed to go smoothly, but there were many dangers involved.
First of all, Su Yu's strength must be enough to be able to drag people into the water during a sneak attack, and then his combat power in the water must be enough, especially the harpoon attack, which must be fast and fierce, without giving the enemy who falls into the water time to react.
Secondly, when killing the second person, it was thanks to Su Hong that he attracted the enemy's attention head-on, giving Su Yu a chance to make a sneak attack.
If there was a slight mistake, the enemy would react and it would turn into a fierce frontal battle, in which case Su Yu would probably be injured.
This is all due to Su Yu's increased strength after practicing boxing, as well as the improved underwater combat power of Fish Bone Kung Fu!
"Second brother, are you okay?" Su Hong stepped forward and asked with concern.
"It's okay." Su Yu waved his hand to calm his heartbeat.
Su Hong looked at the two floating corpses, a hint of appreciation and relief flashed in his eyes. This cousin, who used to be taciturn, is now not only thoughtful, but also decisive and cruel.
In this troubled world, only in this way can we survive better.
"You rest first and I'll take care of it."
Su Hong quickly dragged the two corpses onto the boat and began to touch them.
After a while, two money bags were placed on the deck of the ship.
"Second brother, there are a total of four taels of silver on the two bodies. Take it! Search the boat tent again."
Facing the money handed over by Su Hong, Su Yu wanted to share it equally. After all, his eldest brother also contributed.
However, Su Hong was determined not to, "Second brother, you are learning martial arts now. It is when you need money, take it!" He said and forced it into Su Yu's arms.
Su Yu no longer refused, carefully stuffed the money bag into his arms, turned around and entered the low boat tent.
